decisions.reason: The format reader and writer plug-ins build directly on the firm's core geospatial data integration know-how, have a dedicated web page, and benefit from in-house R&D that lets the firm interpret results and refine them.

The building data digital twin service extends the firm's established offer and its research and standards work, so the firm can learn from early results even though it is only mentioned on the website.

The authentication and identity delegation service sits close to the firm's GIS integration expertise, but it may overlap with the identity service (E) and be merged into it, which slightly raises the risk of withdrawal.

The open GIS application development framework fits the firm's strategy of open, extensible components and its strong in-house development knowledge, so it is well positioned to be assimilated and improved.
The identity and access service for GIS applications was actively announced as enabling seamless integration, is close to the firm's know-how, and is supported by its R&D capacity.
